name: Saito-Hexahedra_psi0.7_1degAngRes_V5
shapeDescription: homogeneous sphere (Lorenz-Mie, Mishchenko spher.f, hat-function average on the TAMUdust2020 grid; GEOSmie_TOA graspkernels)
TAMUdust2020 irregular hexahedra ensemble (Saito et al. 2021, JAS 78, 2089), nominal sphericity 0.7 (ensemble Psi = 0.70064 from TAMUdust2020 A and V); GRASP ratio label 2.986

globalAttrs.history: V5 (2026-10): hexahedra kernels = TAMUdust2020-in-GRASP-kernel-format_2024 kernels_299_* multiplied by alpha = 1.42726 (they had been built as Q_A*pi*r_v^2/V instead of C/V = Q_A*A/V and were low by the sphericity); nominal TAMUdust2020 sphericity S = 0.7, ensemble sphericity from TAMUdust2020 A and V Psi = 0.70064. Sphere entry (ratio 1) added: direct-Mie sphere kernel on the same grid (replaces the interpolated sphere kernel shipped with the 2024 hexahedra, which was 6% high).
